title: See it! Taste it! — новые слова

items.example: Leave your camera at home — it's too heavy for the flight.
Put your mobile in your pocket, not in your bag.
Put your keys in the bag so they're easy to find.
A diary with all your contact information is always in my bag.
These are important, so keep your passport in a pocket.
Is your credit card in your purse or your wallet?
An MP3 player is good for music and audiobooks on a plane.
Earphones are good for watching DVDs on your laptop.
Leave newspapers at home — they're free on the plane.
Take a toothbrush and a small tube of toothpaste.
Wear a sweater on the plane — it's good if it's cold.
Coins are a problem at security, so put them in a purse.
A laptop with an adaptor is my most important thing.
Look — my name's on it. It's my watch.
Most hotels have shampoo, or you can buy it in town.
A souvenir is a nice thing to bring home from a holiday.
